shared_elements: horizontal register band running across the surface
row of repeated identical motifs along a band
fine parallel incised lines used as surface infill/texture
low-relief rounded forms with linear detailing
justification: Both surfaces share only generic formal conventions: a horizontal band above a row of identical repeated relief units, and dense fine parallel incision used to texture forms (the hatched/striated infill in A's upper garment and lower petal band, the fluting in B). The dominant depicted content differs entirely, however: A shows a large multi-spoked wheel with hub as part of a figural scene, while B shows nothing but a rank of repeated vertical fluted, crown-topped elements with no figural or object content.
